claim: Health features are in beta, require Pro, Max or Ultra, and are US only.
quote: Health features are currently in beta, require a Pro, Max, or Ultra plan, and are available in the US only.

claim: The iOS integrations are supported on all Claude plans.
quote: This feature is supported on all Claude plans

claim: Claude reads health data but cannot write or modify Apple Health entries.
quote: Claude can read health data but cannot write or modify entries in Apple Health.

claim: Claude reads health and fitness data from Apple Health.
quote: Claude can read your health and fitness data from Apple Health

claim: Claude reads listed data types from Apple Health with permission.
quote: With your permission, Claude can read the following types of data from Apple Health

claim: Activity metrics data types.
quote: Steps, distance, flights climbed, active calories, exercise minutes, move and stand hours.

claim: Workout data types.
quote: duration, distance, heart rate data, and calories burned

claim: Vitals data types.
quote: Heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), blood pressure, respiratory rate, and blood oxygen.

claim: Body measurement data types.
quote: Weight, height, body mass index, and body fat percentage.

claim: Sleep data types.
quote: Total sleep time, sleep stages, time in bed, and sleep efficiency.

claim: Nutrition data types.
quote: Calories consumed, macronutrients, water intake, and micronutrients (if tracked).

claim: Claude displays insights with native iOS charts.
quote: Claude displays health insights using native iOS charts that appear directly in your conversation.

claim: Some data types require an Apple Watch or compatible device.
quote: Some data types require an Apple Watch or compatible device.

claim: A recently started metric may lack history for trend analysis.
quote: there may not be enough historical data for trend analysis

claim: Claude requests access to health data if not already granted.
quote: Claude will request access to your health data if not already granted.

claim: Health data is accessed only when a question requires it and permission is granted.
quote: only when you ask a question that requires this information and have granted permission

claim: Health permissions work differently from other permissions.
quote: Health permissions work differently from other app permissions.

claim: The standard iOS Health permissions screen lets users choose data types.
quote: you'll see the standard iOS Health permissions screen where you can choose exactly which data types to share

claim: Health permissions are modified in Settings > Health > Data Access & Devices > Claude.
quote: You can modify these permissions at any time by going to Settings > Health > Data Access & Devices > Claude.

claim: Other permissions offer Allow once, Always allow or Don't allow.
quote: You’ll be prompted to approve the action with three options: Allow once, Always allow, or Don't allow.

claim: By default Claude does not save health information to memory.
quote: By default, Claude doesn't save health information to memory.

claim: With Include sensitive topics in memory on, Claude may remember health context.
quote: Claude may remember health-related context from your conversations

claim: Tool use is preserved in conversation history like any tool.
quote: their use is preserved in the conversation history in the same way as any tool

claim: The help article lists a separate Android apps article.
quote: Use Claude with Android apps

claim: Announcement: US Pro and Max subscribers can give Claude access to lab results and health records.
quote: In the US, Claude Pro and Max plan subscribers can choose to give Claude secure access to their lab results and health records.

claim: HealthEx and Function connectors are in beta.
quote: New HealthEx and Function connectors are available in beta today

claim: Apple Health and Android Health Connect integrations rolling out in beta via iOS and Android apps.
quote: Apple Health and Android Health Connect integrations are rolling out in beta this week via the Claude iOS and Android apps

claim: When connected, Claude can summarize history, explain results, detect patterns and prepare questions.
quote: When connected, Claude can summarize users’ medical history, explain test results in plain language, detect patterns across fitness and health metrics, and prepare questions for appointments.

claim: Users must explicitly opt in.
quote: must explicitly opt-in to enable access

claim: Users can disconnect or edit Claude's permissions at any time.
quote: can disconnect or edit Claude’s permissions at any time

claim: Users choose the information they share.
quote: Users can choose exactly the information they share with Claude

claim: Anthropic does not use users' health data to train models.
quote: We do not use users’ health data to train models.

claim: The announcement was published January 11, 2026.
quote: Published Jan 11, 2026
